text: A small bird brought news... of a queen who worshipped the sun.
Hazrat Sulaiman, alayhis salaam, looked among the birds. The hoopoe was missing.
Then it came back and said: I have come to you from Sheba, with certain news.
I found a woman ruling them, with a great throne. And they bow to the sun, instead of Allah.
In the end, the queen herself said: My Lord, I have wronged myself, and I submit with Sulaiman to Allah.
